result.topic_en: Scattered calculations on linear relations between variables x_i, ζ_i with parameters λ_i, μ_i, including the vanishing of sums of square roots of products (a Göpel/Rosenhain-type relation), case distinctions, and a side calculation with powers of 2 of the form 2^{p-2}(2^p-1).
